lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {s : Set E}
  {f : E → ℝ} {m : ℝ} {grad : E → E},
  Convex ℝ s →
    (∀ z ∈ s, HasGradientAt f (grad z) z) →
      (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, m * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (grad y - grad x) (y - x)) → StrongConvexOn s m f
approved_definition_context: E is a real normed additive group with a real inner product inducing its norm. CompleteSpace means that every Cauchy filter converges.
Convex ℝ s means that s contains a • x + b • y whenever x,y∈s, a,b≥0 and a+b=1.
HasGradientAt f (g z) z means that f has an ambient Frechet derivative at z represented by v ↦ inner ℝ (g z) v. It does not mean only a derivative within s.

StrongConvexOn s m f means Convex ℝ s and, for all x,y∈s and all nonnegative real a,b with a+b=1, f(a • x+b • y) ≤ a*f(x)+b*f(y)−a*b*(m/2*norm(x−y)^2). The definition itself imposes no sign restriction on m.
